name: validation
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun test core/count-write-frames.test.ts core/count-focused.test.ts core/count-ranges.test.ts core/count-recovery/empty-count-source.test.ts core/count-recovery/derivability-closure.test.ts core/count-recovery/row-demand.test.ts core/count-recovery/row-cases.test.ts core/count-recovery/conditional-cuts.test.ts; bun run check; for file in audit-fix-commit.txt transport-commit.txt audit-report-commit.txt triangle-core-commit.txt; do printf 'COMMITLINT %s\n' "$file"; bunx commitlint --default-config < "$file"; done
